observations.behavior: Adds DateTime import and a new test asserting that an explicit timestamp is truncated to the hour.
observations.posthog_connection: Adds hour-grain truncation to AppMetricsAggregator, changing the aggregation key to include the hour. This could allow billing and retention to be grouped by calendar hour rather than by flush time, potentially supporting tiered billing or retention policies that depend on calendar boundaries. observations.behavior: Adds a new private method queueRetentionByteDays to LogsIngestionConsumer. This method iterates through retention days, chunking them into 30-day blocks, and queues a usage metric for each block. The queued metric is dated at the start of its month, not the ingestion day. observations.posthog_connection: This could allow PostHog to bill storage retention on a per-month basis rather than a per-ingestion-day basis, potentially changing the billing cycle and the accounting of retained data.
